reviews.author: F. Al-Mansoori
reviews.text: Coordination from the first consult to discharge felt like one case, not scattered across agents. The itemized quote matched the final bill.

reviews.author: G. Oduya
reviews.text: The physio team was excellent. Airport pickup ran late on arrival, but the coordinator sorted it out quickly.

reviews.author: M. Rahman
reviews.text: The transplant coordinator explained every document the committee needed. A long stay, but we never felt lost.

reviews.author: S. Chowdhury
reviews.text: Clear about what medication was and wasn't included — no surprises at the end.

reviews.author: A. Benali
reviews.text: Quick and well organised. I would have liked my discharge notes in French as well as English.

reviews.author: D. Petrov
reviews.text: Pre-op tests were done within two days of landing, with a Russian-speaking interpreter throughout.

reviews.author: J. Murphy
reviews.text: The surgeon designed the hairline personally and the hotel transfers were seamless.

reviews.author: K. Alotaibi
reviews.text: Good result. It's a busy clinic, so book the second visit well in advance.

reviews.author: E. Johnson
reviews.text: A calm, hotel-like hospital. Swelling went down exactly as they said it would.

reviews.author: P. Santoso
reviews.text: The tumour board gave us a clear plan with costs for each stage before we travelled.

reviews.author: R. Alvarez
reviews.text: The shuttle from San Diego made it easy, and the dietitian check-ins continued after I got home.

reviews.author: L. Chen
reviews.text: Saved a lot compared with quotes at home. Two trips were needed, which they explained upfront.

reviews.author: H. Al-Balushi
reviews.text: Close to home with everything in Arabic. Pricier than India, but worth it for our family.

reviews.author: N. Putri
reviews.text: A kind team and clear pricing. Monitoring started at home before we flew.
